title: Course-review front-matter
description: Contract for course-review.mdx front-matter (Spec 008 FR-006, contract: specs/008-rich-unit-pedagogy/contracts/end-of-course-review.md). A course-level end-matter page: course summary, practice-question bank, practicum project ideas, and a bounded '## Answers and marking guidance' final section. Optional file. Answer-key front-matter fields are forbidden (only prose answers inside the bounded body section are permitted). This file is the ONLY content file allowed sidebar_position.

course_code.description: Must match the parent course folder (uppercased).

sidebar_position.description: The single sanctioned sidebar_position in content. Convention: 900, so the page sorts after the last unit-NN folder. Mirror the same value in the UR i18n copy.

bilingual.description: Inherited meaning from course-overview: false marks an English-only course, exempt from the EN<->UR parity gate.

resources.description: Optional further-reading pointers for the whole course - cited only, never reproduced (Constitution III.5).
